aria: Animated recap of the Knicks' 117 to 85 home win over Milwaukee: Tyler Kolek's 3-pointer with 8:43 left in the second quarter that put New York up by double digits for good, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Karl-Anthony Towns's 21 points and 16 rebounds, the top scorers, how the Knicks won, and the next game against Cleveland.
notes: Box score from the Knicks' 117–85 win over the Milwaukee Bucks at Madison Square Garden on Nov 10, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from Field Level Media, the New York Post (via Yahoo Sports), SB Nation (via Yahoo Sports) and the Plain Text Sports play-by-play. All 117 Knicks points and all 85 Bucks points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (58–34 at the half, matching Field Level Media and Yahoo Sports). The 32-point lead and Milwaukee's 3-point lead are Covers'. Team totals (rebounds, offensive rebounds, points in the paint, free throws, fast-break points, Milwaukee's 30 of 79 shooting) are Covers'. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Tuesday's games: New York 6–4 and fourth in the East, Milwaukee 1–10, Cleveland 5–6.

Milwaukee won the third quarter 38–27 and opened the fourth by pulling within 11 at 85–74, before Towns and Kolek scored the first 14 points of a 20–2 New York run (Field Level Media). Towns's double-double in all 10 games this season is from the New York Post (Field Level Media counts 14 straight regular-season games dating to April 1). Landry Shamet started in place of Josh Hart, who missed a third straight game (New York Post). The Knicks play Cleveland at home on Wednesday at 7:00 PM ET, the second night of a back-to-back (Plain Text Sports schedule); they won 109–97 at Cleveland on Saturday, Nov 7.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Tyler Kolek's 23-foot 3-pointer, assisted by Jordan Clarkson, with 8:43 left in the second quarter, which made it 34–23 and put New York ahead by double digits for good (Field Level Media; the Plain Text Sports play-by-play has the same clock and score, from 31–23). The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the New York Knicks or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Kolek’s listed 6-foot-2 and 195 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-2.75 draft-combine wingspan (Sportskeeda), in the Knicks' home white with No. 13 (Basketball-Reference). He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
